        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_EnterNextServiceTime</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_NextServiceRecorded</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_PreviousServiceSuccessful" name="Previous service successful"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_ServiceNecessary" name="Service is necessary">

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_JoinToPayment" sourceRef="Gateway_ServiceWorkJoin" targetRef="Task_PayThroughApp"/>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Registered" name="Car still registered?" default="Flow_NotRegistered"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_NotifyOwner" name="Notify the car owner"/>
    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="Gateway_ServiceOrFine" name="Wait for service visit or 30 days"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_OwnerGoesToService" name="Car owner goes to the service facility">
      <bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition id="ConditionalEventDefinition_OwnerGoes">
        <bpmn:condition xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">owner_goes_to_service</bpmn:condition>
      </bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_ThirtyDays" name="30 days pass without a service visit">
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition id="TimerEventDefinition_ThirtyDays">
        <bpmn:timeDuration xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">P30D</bpmn:timeDuration>
      </bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_IssueFine" name="Fine the car owner"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Fined" name="Car owner fined"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_NotRegistered" name="Car is not registered"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterProblems" name="Enter the car problems for reference"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ParallelSplit" name="Repair and receive status updates"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RepairCar" name="Repair the car"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_ReceiveStatusUpdates" name="Receive status updates by email while waiting (possibly several days)">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_StatusUpdate" messageRef="Message_StatusUpdate"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ParallelJoin" name="Repair and status updates complete"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_PayThroughApp" name="Pay through the app when the repair is done"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterSuccessfulRepair" name="Enter that the repair was successful and the car got its Pickerl"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterNextService" name="Enter the time for the next service"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_NextServiceRecorded" name="Next service time recorded"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_01" sourceRef="StartEvent_ServiceSuccessful" targetRef="Event_ServiceNecessary"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_02" sourceRef="Event_ServiceNecessary" targetRef="Task_CheckRegistration"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_03" sourceRef="Task_CheckRegistration" targetRef="Gateway_Registered"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_04" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_Registered" targetRef="Task_NotifyOwner">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">car_is_registered</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotRegistered" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_Registered" targetRef="EndEvent_NotRegistered"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_06" sourceRef="Task_NotifyOwner" targetRef="Gateway_ServiceOrFine"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_07" sourceRef="Gateway_ServiceOrFine" targetRef="Event_OwnerGoesToService"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_08" sourceRef="Gateway_ServiceOrFine" targetRef="Event_ThirtyDays"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_09" sourceRef="Event_ThirtyDays" targetRef="Task_IssueFine"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Task_IssueFine" targetRef="EndEvent_Fined"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="Event_OwnerGoesToService" targetRef="Task_EnterProblems"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="Task_EnterProblems" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelSplit" targetRef="Task_RepairCar"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelSplit" targetRef="Event_ReceiveStatusUpdates"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_15" sourceRef="Task_RepairCar" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_16" sourceRef="Event_ReceiveStatusUpdates" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_17" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelJoin" targetRef="Task_PayThroughApp"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_18" sourceRef="Task_PayThroughApp" targetRef="Task_EnterSuccessfulRepair"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_19" sourceRef="Task_EnterSuccessfulRepair" targetRef="Task_EnterNextService"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_20" sourceRef="Task_EnterNextService" targetRef="EndEvent_NextServiceRecorded"/>
  </bpmn:process>

rules.instruction: When the description states that a participant enters information or other inputs as a distinct action: Model that action as a separate activity in the appropriate sequence; do not omit it or absorb it into another activity.
rules.situation: the description identifies a participant's distinct action of recording information or an outcome.

rules.instruction: When the description states an activity or outcome and identifies its action, object, actor, or recipient: label the corresponding BPMN element with concise wording that preserves those stated details and does not substitute a different action or meaning
rules.situation: the description states an activity or outcome and identifies its action, object, actor, recipient, direction, or timing

rules.instruction: When the description states that an activity, event, or decision outcome leads to a specific next action: connect the corresponding BPMN elements with sequence flows, including the stated successor of each branch
rules.situation: the description states that a decision outcome leads to a specific activity, or that concurrent activities must all finish before a shared next activity

rules.instruction: When the description states who performs an activity, who receives a communication, or what outcome or condition occurs: Label each BPMN element to preserve the described action, actor or recipient, and outcome; do not change who sends or receives a communication or replace a stated activity or outcome with a different one.
rules.situation: the description states who performs an activity, who receives a communication, or what outcome or condition occurs

rules.instruction: When the description says that a participant receives message updates while waiting for another activity to finish: Model the wait for those updates as an intermediate message catch event, not as an activity that sends them.
rules.situation: the description says that a participant receives message updates while waiting for another activity to finish
